title: Lear Siegler ADM-3A Terminal
summary: Photo of a Lear Siegler ADM-3A 'dumb terminal', a portable glass tty from the 1970s
description: Photo of a Lear Siegler ADM-3A terminal. This compact, affordable terminal was widely used in the 1970s and is the kind of 'glass tty' that could plausibly be carried into a hospital. Source: Wikimedia Commons.
